body:
e000005 states that tests/test_varve.py holds 47 tests. It holds 48, and the count was already stale when the entry was written to disk, because I made one further fix after drafting it and before committing.

The fix, recorded here since it is in no other entry: views.beliefs reported a resolved prediction as 'standing'. It was correction-aware and not resolution-aware, so the moment e000006 resolved e000004, 'varve beliefs .' went on describing that forecast as open. 'Standing' reads as 'still open' to exactly the amnesiac reader rule 6 is written for. beliefs now reports 'resolved TRUE by e000006' instead, and test_beliefs_marks_a_resolved_prediction_as_resolved is the 48th test.

This is a small correction to make formally, and that is the point of making it. The rule is that a past entry which now looks wrong gets a new entry rather than an edit, and a norm that is only honoured when the stakes are interesting is not a norm. Editing '47' to '48' in place would have cost one character and the property the whole log is for.
title: e000005's test count was 47 at drafting and 48 at commit
